nodes.label: 9203c55
nodes.title: feat: Implement comprehensive mood analysis system
nodes.author: mvrock
nodes.message:
feat: Implement comprehensive mood analysis system with detailed questions

- Add mood detail questions screen with score-based branching
  - 1-3 points (negative): 4 questions
  - 4-6 points (neutral): 3 questions
  - 7-10 points (positive): 3 questions
- Implement category and score-based question types
  - Category questions for pattern analysis (work, relationship, health, etc.)
  - Score questions (1-4 scale) for severity measurement
- Update Firestore schema to support detailed mood data
  - Add detailedAnswers, detailScore, and categories fields
  - Calculate average score from score-type questions
- Enhance main screen mood tracking flow
  - Add _isMoodSelected state tracking
  - Enable button only after mood selection
  - Navigate to detail questions screen
- Improve UI/UX
  - Radio button style selection with visual feedback
  - Purple border (#8B5CF6) and check icon for selected items
  - Mandatory answer validation
  - Loading state during submission
- Update FirestoreService.updateMoodScore() with optional parameters

nodes.label: bf13243
nodes.title: feat: Add Wear OS app for HRV measurement using He
nodes.author: mvrock
nodes.message:
feat: Add Wear OS app for HRV measurement using Health Services API

## Summary
- Wear OS 앱 구현하여 Galaxy Watch에서 직접 HRV 측정
- Health Services API 사용으로 고품질 IBI 데이터 수집
- Data Layer API로 폰 앱과 실시간 데이터 통신
- Flutter 앱에서 워치 HRV 데이터 수신 및 Firestore 저장

## Added
- `android/wear/` 모듈: Wear OS 앱 전체
  - MainActivity: 권한 요청 및 서비스 시작
  - HrvMonitorService: Health Services API로 HRV 측정 (5분 주기)
  - SensorTestActivity: 사용 가능한 센서 확인
- `WearDataListenerService`: 워치로부터 데이터 수신 (폰 앱)

## Modified
- `app/build.gradle.kts`: Wearable Data Layer 의존성 추가
- `app/AndroidManifest.xml`: WearDataListenerService 등록
- `MainActivity.kt`: 워치 데이터 조회 메서드 추가
- `settings.gradle.kts`: wear 모듈 추가
- `health_service.dart`: 워치 HRV 데이터 수신 메서드 추가

## Technical Details
- Health Services API로 HEART_RATE_BPM + IBI 데이터 수집
- RMSSD 계산 알고리즘 구현
- Wearable Data Layer API로 폰-워치 통신
- 1분 측정, 4분 대기로 5분 주기 자동 측정

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

nodes.message:
feat: Integrate Health Connect for HRV data management

Refactor HRV data flow to use Health Connect as the central data store.

- **WearDataListenerService:** Modified to directly save incoming HRV data from the watch to Health Connect.
- **MainActivity:**
  - Updated  to include  access for .
  - Implemented  to read HRV data directly from Health Connect.
  - Removed the  method channel handler as data is now accessed via Health Connect.

This change improves data integrity, security, and scalability by leveraging Health Connect as a robust storage solution.
